a: The fictional town of Elmbridge published its annual transport review for the demonstration dataset. The review describes bus routes, passenger counts, maintenance schedules, funding decisions and service changes. Officials recorded observations during four seasons and compared weekday journeys with weekend journeys. The report separates measured outcomes from proposed improvements and does not attribute every change to one policy. Tables provide the underlying counts, while an appendix explains sampling procedures and missing observations. Residents can inspect the original survey forms and the definitions used for each category. An independent auditor examined the arithmetic but did not evaluate the causal effects of the programme. The authors warn that weather, road closures and changes in working patterns may affect the results. Future reviews will use the same definitions where possible and identify any departures explicitly.
